{{Quote|Most of us just did whatever we could to make it over the finish line. Say, did you ever see a Podrace?''"<br/>"''I've seen a few, but&hellip; nothing like what you guys must have done. From what I've heard, I'm afraid most of the greatest Podraces happened before I was born.''"<br/>"''Ain't that the lousy truth, brother.|Ody Mandrell and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="A New Hope: The Life of Luke Skywalker">''[[A New Hope: The Life of Luke Skywalker]]''</ref>}}
'''Ody Mandrell''' was a [[Er'Kit (species)/Legends|Er'Kit]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] born and raised on the dusty [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Biography==
One of the youngest Podracers to participate in the sport, Ody was barely more than a teenager. His naturally resilient skin, an inherent characteristic of nearly all Er'Kit, allowed him to walk away from most of his crashes nearly unscathed&mdash;and Mandrell experienced more crashes than most. The quintessential daredevil, Mandrell raced not for money or fame, but simply for the adrenaline rush. He relished mind-boggling risk, and constantly flew at top speed, edging around corners by the seat of his pants as he whooped and laughed like a madman.

Mandrell was a powerful contender in the midrace battles that frequented [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]]. With his powerful [[Exelbrok/Legends|Exelbrok]] [[XL 5115 engine]], he could deliver serious damage to other racers, and it never seemed to bother him that they might be better pilots. Fans enjoyed his bravado, and he was a favorite among the spectators of the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]]. During the race in which [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] won his freedom, During a risky<ref name=":0" /> maneuver, Ody's Podracer was disabled in the pits when the droid [[DUM-4/Legends|DUM-4]] was sucked into one massive engine and spat out the other end. However, he was able to repair the engine after the race, and was soon back on the Podracing circuit.

During the [[Galactic Games/Legends|Galactic Games]] of [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]], Ody Mandrell crashed his podracer in an illegal [[Great Dordon Caves|Caves]] race on the planet [[Euceron]]. Fourteen-year-old Jedi Padawan Anakin Skywalker competed in and won that race, but he had to push his own engines as hard as he dared in order to outrun Mandrell's crash smoke so it wouldn't blind him. Other competitors included [[Hekula]] (son of [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]]), [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]], [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]], [[Kam Nale|Elan Mak]], "Scorch" [[Zanales]], and [[Will Neluenf]].<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games">''[[Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games]]''</ref>

Mandrell dominated on Dethro's Revenge on Ord Ibanna and was the track's favorite there.

Ody remained on Tatooine, where he worked in the old [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]], now a [[Swoop racing/Legends|Swoop racing]] arena after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] banned Podracing. He was employed by [[Ulda]] alongside his previous competitor, [[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto Pagalies]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], several months after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] came to the arena seeking information on his father, Anakin. Ody and Teemto recalled the events of the Boonta Eve Classic for the young Skywalker and pointed him to Anakin's friend [[W. Wald]] for more information.<ref name="A New Hope: The Life of Luke Skywalker" />

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] appeared at the Arena looking for a fast transport to catch the runaway [[Kitster Chanchani Banai]] and recover the [[grass painting]] ''[[Killik Twilight]]'', it was Ody who prepared Han with [[Rao]]'s swoop bike, which was basically a Podracer engine with a seat attached.<ref name="Tatooine Ghost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I've seen better parts at a waste dump.|Ody Mandrell taunts an opponent|translated=1|audio=OdyMandrell-taunt.flac|<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: Racer">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']]</ref>}}
Relishing in deifying death at every turn, Mandrell participated in the high-speed and high-risk contests of Podracing due to the exhilarating adrenaline rush they provided.<ref name="Galactic Files">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 2|cardname=Ody Mandrell|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewSet.cfm/sid/93283/2013-Topps-Star-Wars:-Galactic-Files-Series-2}}</ref> The reckless menace had little respect for other lifeforms,<ref name="Pocket" /> or his other racers,<ref name="DB" /> and had an insatiable appetite for thrills of high speed.<ref name="Pocket">''[[Star Wars Episode I Who's Who: A Pocket Guide to the Characters of The Phantom Menace]]''</ref> Other Podracers were convinced that Mandrell had a death wish<ref name=":0" /> and had [[xenonutritionists]] studied the Podracer, they would have come to the conclusion that the Er'Kit [[Species/Legends|species]] fed off speed and adrenaline.<ref name="DB" />

The Er'Kit [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="DB" /> had [[Color/Legends|light blue]] skin with pink and yellow stripes, and black-colored [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Toy" /> Mandrell weighed 58 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]],<ref name="H2H" /> and at his height of 1.63 [[Meter/Legends|meters]],<ref name="DB" /> he was considered short and squat by the standards of the Er'Kit species.<ref name=":0" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mandrell's voice in ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Racer Revenge]]'' was provided by [[Bob Bergen]].

In the Episode I novel, Ody Mandrell returned to the 32 BBY podrace after his pit stop accident, but he crashed when his podracer over-banked.
[[File:OdyandBolesConcept.png|thumb|The early design of Ody Mandrell, first being called Ody Mysturall, and his species design first set to be Boles Roor.]]
During development, Ody Mandrell was created, but at this time was known as "Ody Mysturall", with a differing design. In concept art, Ody Mysturall was concepted as a tall creature, with longer, lankier legs and arms, and having a (possibly) fused head and body with a long snarling mouth with small, evil-like slanted eyes and small antennae. The name Ody Mysturall made it as far as appearing in post-production art and the animatics stage of the Boonta Eve Classic scene, with Ody Mysturall labeled to his finalized podracer that appears in the final film (albeit all colored red), but was later redesigned.

In said redesign, Ody Mandrell, while labeled as Ody Mysturall, had his species designed labeled by the name [[Boles Roor]], who would later become his own podracer pilot who would appear in the race. Of course, the species was assigned by the name of Boles Roor, would later be assigned to Ody Mysturall, now under the name of Ody Mandrell, and would scrap the Ody Mysturall design, and keep the design that would appear in the finished product.

[[File:Ody_mandrell4.jpg|thumb|left|150px|An early production model of the character used on some merchandise]]
Ody Mandrell's podracer was first possibly assigned as [[Mawhonic/Legends|Mawhonic's]] podracer, with concept art grid showing not only the scrapped podracers who would have appeared in the film (who would later appear in ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]''), but did show that Mandrell's podracer was supposed to be Mawhonic's, whereas Mawhonic's [[GPE-3130 Podracer/Legends|podracer]] that would appear in the final film, was indeed signed to Ody Mandrell. Additionally, [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]] was meant to drive in Ody Mandrell's podracer, before he was replaced with an earlier design of Mawhonic, who would later be designed as a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]], switch their pods, and eventually settled on their current podracers and designs seen in the final film.
